               (42,46,93),(52,48,94),(61,51,94),(70,54,95),(80,59,93),
               (87,62,88),(92,66,83),(95,70,78)])

        d.ellipse((159.7*S,104*S,161.5*S,105.6*S),fill=(211,86,32,230))
